title: Compressor-1 night shift anomaly
text: During the night shift Compressor-1 drew unusually high energy. Power stayed above 92 kW while production was idle. Inspect unload valve leakage and the pressure setpoint.

title: Boiler feed pump power factor
text: Boiler feed pump MTR-21 showed low power factor of 0.68 and increased reactive power during the morning shift. Check capacitor bank and motor loading.

title: Packaging line normal operation
text: Packaging Line-2 consumed 41 kWh during the day shift. Load followed the production schedule and no anomaly was detected.

title: Chiller temperature-driven load
text: Cold-store Chiller-2 energy increased during a hot afternoon. Ambient temperature was 39 C and cooling production was high, so the expected-load model marked it normal.

title: Conveyor bearing warning
text: Conveyor CV-07 current rose gradually with repeated energy spikes. Maintenance found a worn bearing creating mechanical drag and replaced it.

title: Air leak after production
text: Compressor-2 kept cycling after the evening shift ended. Abnormal off-hours consumption was traced to a compressed-air leak near the dyeing section.

title: Textile loom voltage imbalance
text: Loom bank LB-03 reported phase voltage imbalance and elevated current on phase B. The event caused motor heating but only a small energy increase.

title: Idle oven weekend waste
text: Baking Oven-1 remained at standby temperature on Sunday with no production. Weekend idle consumption reached 310 kWh; shutdown scheduling was recommended.

title: Injection moulding heater fault
text: Injection Moulder IM-04 used high power because a barrel heater thermostat failed. Energy remained elevated across three production batches.

title: Meter communication gap
text: Main meter M-00 stopped reporting for eighteen minutes. The ingestion quality check flagged missing readings; this was a communication issue, not an energy anomaly.

title: Compressor pressure setpoint
text: Compressor-1 total consumption increased by 18 percent after the pressure setpoint was raised for night production. Resetting pressure reduced kWh without affecting output.

title: Motor power factor correction
text: Motor MTR-09 had low power factor and high reactive energy. After capacitor correction, current fell and monthly demand charges were reduced.

title: Welding peak demand
text: Welding Bay-2 created a short peak-demand event when several welders started together. Staggered startup was recommended to lower the demand peak.

title: Cold room door loss
text: Cold Room CR-1 consumed excess energy overnight because a door seal was damaged. Chiller runtime and temperature deviations confirmed the cooling loss.

title: Scheduled maintenance shutdown
text: All production meters showed near-zero load during the planned maintenance shutdown. The calendar context explains the readings and prevents a false anomaly alert.
